title: File:President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance with Taoiseach Micheál Martin.jpg
art: The Office of Vice President of the United States
desc:
Usha and I were honored to host Taoiseach @MichealMartinTD and his wife, Mary, for breakfast at the Naval Observatory, followed by a great meeting with President Trump in the Oval Office.
It was a great day for celebrating our longstanding alliance with Ireland 🇺🇸🇮🇪
